title: Inseq: An Interpretability Toolkit for Sequence Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using a synthetic Turkish-to-English machine translation setup with gender-neutral pronouns, computing feature attribution scores (e.g., Integrated Gradients, Gradients) and pronoun probabilities for different occupation terms, and correlating these metrics with U.S. labor statistics on the percentage of women in those fields. Also uses contrastive attribution for gender-swapped target pronouns.
